data: NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 (the year ended January 28, 2024) produced revenue of about $60.9 billion, up 126% from $27.0 billion in fiscal 2023. Gross profit was roughly $44.3 billion, which works out to a gross margin of about 72.7%, compared with 56.9% the prior year. Operating income was approximately $32.97 billion, giving an operating margin of about 54.1%, up from roughly 15.7% in fiscal 2023 when operating income was $4.2 billion. The jump reflected surging data center demand for AI accelerators, along with a fiscal 2023 base that was depressed by inventory charges and a larger share of lower-margin gaming sales. These figures are from memory of NVIDIA's reported results, so check them against the 10-K if you need exact numbers.
